# Where things come from

<!-- Generated by tools/build_provenance_map.py. Do not edit by hand:
     rebuild it instead, so it stays tied to the manifest and the
     task table rather than drifting from them. -->

Which code produces which published item. Everything here is read out
of the files that already define it, so this map cannot disagree with
the pipeline without the generator disagreeing too.

## Running the pipeline

```
python -m persistence --all --resume        # the whole analysis
python -m persistence --ref combined --only s3   # one section
python tools/replot_from_data.py S26 --results-root RUN/results
```

`persistence/` is the analysis package: `__main__.py` is the entry
point and dispatches to the section modules below. `tools/` holds
standalone scripts run before or after it -- builders, audits and
one-off checks. `figures/` holds the main-text figure scripts.

## Figure tasks

What `python -m persistence --figure full` runs, and what each
task is for. These produce a figure the first time; the table above
is how to redraw one afterwards.

| Task | Script | Produces |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accum_sinf` | `tools/make_accumulation_sinf_figures.py` | Figures S16/S17 finite-catalogue S-infinity accumulation |
| `accumulation_summary` | `summary_accumulation_figure.py` | Accumulation summary figure |
| `accumulation_v3` | `accumulation_summary_v3.py` | Advanced accumulation summary v3 |
| `bayes_section2` | `section2_bayesian_figure.py` | Bayesian Section 2 figure |
| `demographics` | `make_demographic_associations.py` | demographic associations (age / sex / BMI) |
| `figure1` | `figure1.py` | Main Figure 1 Equal Earth sample map |
| `figure2` | `figure2.py` | Main Figure 2 composite |
| `figure3` | `figure3.py` | Main Figure 3 accumulation composite |
| `figure3_hill` | `make_combined_figure3.py` | Figure S15 accumulation composite, hill model |
| `figure4` | `figure4.py` | Main Figure 4 differential prevalence/abundance composite |
| `figure5` | `figure5.py` | Main Figure 5 health composite |
| `guide_fig5` | `figure_s_guide_fig5.py` | Supplemental guide for Figure 5 |
| `metadata_map` | `make_metadata_equal_earth.py` | Equal Earth metadata map |
| `metadata_summary` | `make_metadata_summary.py` | Metadata summary figures and CSVs |
| `occupancy_a17` | `figure_a17_occupancy.py` | Figure A17: occupancy / detect-in->=k accumulation (combined reference) |
| `rarefaction` | `rarefaction_plugin.py` | Rarefaction/accumulation plugin figure |
| `read_accounting` | `make_read_accounting.py` | Figure S1 read accounting and reference recovery |
| `roadmap` | `figure_s0_roadmap_v4.py` | Figure S31 analytic roadmap |
| `supp_fixed_bases` | `make_supp_figure_fixed_bases.py` | Fixed-bases supplemental figure assembly |
| `supp_link` | `tools/link_supplementary_figures.py` | supplementary_figures/: S-numbered symlinks into results/ |
| `supp_stage` | `tools/stage_figures_for_docx.py` | staged_figures/: the supplementary set resampled to 6.3 in / 220 dpi |
| `table_s2b` | `tools/build_table_s2b_cohorts.py` | Table S2b: cohort cascade, samples and hosts, per reference |
| `tables_s4_s5` | `make_tables_s4_s5.py` | Supplementary Tables S4/S5 |

## Supplementary tables

| Item | Built from | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Table_S1 | `table_s1a_study_summary_formatted.csv` | High-level per-study summary of included studies |
| Table_S2 | — | Cohort derivation and exclusion cascade - assembled from run stats, not a standalone CSV |
| Table_S3 | — | Figure-specific cohort matrix - not a standalone pipeline output |
| Table_S4 | `combined_sgb_metadata.xlsx` | Comparison of Carter/UHGG and Leviatan catalogues (headline counts, cross-ANI, GTDB phyla) |

| Table_S6 | `section2_differential/main/macro_pooling_detection_10pct.csv` | Detection statistics across thresholds for VANISH/BloSSUM (per-threshold pooling; confirm) |
| Table_S7 | `section2_differential/main/*detection_pooling_*10pct.csv` | Pooled detection/absence of original VANISH & BloSSUM taxa across sample pooling (main pipeline, 10% threshold) |
| Table_S8 | `section2_differential/main/extinction_candidates_vanish_blossum_plus_30pct.csv` | VANISH+/BloSSUM+ SGBs not found in >3 samples (30% variant; 10% not emitted) |
| Table_S9 | — | Per-condition health case/control cohort summary - not emitted as a standalone CSV |
| Table_S10 | `section3_health/main/health_per_condition_cmh_10pct.csv` | GMW-CMH depleted/enriched taxa counts per list and condition |

## Metadata tables

| Item | Built from | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Metadata_M1 | `metadata_M1.csv` | Curated per-sample metadata (18,048 samples; SRA-enriched read length/count) |
| Metadata_M1_per_study | `section1_diversity/supplement/per_study_metadata.csv` | Per-study rollup of M1 (author/country/N/depth/lifestyle) |
| Metadata_M2 | `metadata_M2.xlsx` | Reference-catalogue metadata for all three catalogues (Carter/UHGG, Leviatan, Combined): clustering, cross-ANI, GTDB, genome lengths |
| Metadata_M3 | `metadata_M3.xlsx` | VANISH/BloSSUM taxon-list metadata: six list families x two references, membership, taxonomy, pairwise overlaps |
